checks.detail: No lock waits: no session is blocked.

audit.report: A replayable batch job (inventory_reconcile, pid 339741) held an idle-in-transaction lock for 4.1 seconds, blocking checkout sessions and degrading success to 27% over 30 seconds. The Database Guardian initially proposed waiting, but after gathering workload metadata (replayable, 4-minute replay cost, may_interrupt policy), change-calendar status (no active window), and protected-settlement status (none), the trade-off analysis showed waiting would cost ~$201k in lost revenue and exceed the 60-second degradation tolerance. Both guardians agreed to terminate the blocker in a single round. Execution terminated the session, and verification confirmed full recovery: zero lock waits, 100% checkout success over 10 seconds, and no protected operations affected. Total incident duration was 83.4 seconds.
audit.root_cause: An idle-in-transaction batch worker (batch_replayable_inventory) held a lock that blocked checkout sessions, causing widespread timeouts.
lessons: For batch_replayable_inventory: ensure the job emits heartbeat/progress telemetry so guardians can distinguish a truly stuck transaction from a slow but healthy one without waiting for lock waits to accumulate.

For batch_replayable_inventory: add a statement_timeout or idle_in_transaction_session_timeout at the role/session level so long-idle transactions self-terminate before they breach the 60-second checkout degradation budget.
audit.negotiation_critique: The Database Guardian efficiently pivoted from wait to terminate within the same round after probing for missing evidence (workload registry, change calendar, protected settlements, business impact), and the Continuity Guardian accepted immediately with no objections; no rounds were wasted and no invariants were violated.
follow_ups: Configure idle_in_transaction_session_timeout for the batch_worker role to auto-terminate idle transactions after a safe threshold (e.g., 30s).
Instrument inventory_reconcile to publish checkpoint progress to the workload registry for real-time replay-cost accuracy.
Add a pre-flight check in the batch deployment pipeline to verify statement_timeout settings are applied to replayable jobs.
